title: Martians built the moon as a transport and terraforming device

tellings.quote: the people on Mars probably constructed the moon for two purposes.

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani suggests that people living on Mars probably built the Moon, for two purposes: to carry things across space and to reshape Earth so it could support life. He offers this as his own reading, drawing on Joe McMoneagle, a man known for remote viewing, the practice of trying to perceive distant places with the mind, and on a work called Closer Encounters; if true, the Moon would be a made object rather than a natural one.
